title: Prisma.validator removed in Prisma 5 — correlation test broken
disprove_gate: Run vitest __tests__/correlation-load-settled-picks.test.ts — if it passes the fix is valid

title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header on all routes
evidence: apps/web/next.config.mjs: no CSP key in headers()
disprove_gate: After fix: grep Content-Security-Policy next.config.mjs vercel.json — both must match

title: images.domains deprecated; should be remotePatterns
disprove_gate: After fix: grep -v domains next.config.mjs should return nothing; remotePatterns present

title: CRITICAL npm vuln: vitest <=4.1.0-beta.6 arbitrary file read via UI server
evidence: GHSA: Vitest UI server arbitrary file read/execute
disprove_gate: Vitest UI is only exposed with --ui flag; CI uses `vitest run` which never starts UI server. Risk is dev-env only.
blocked_question: Is Vitest UI (vitest --ui) ever run in a shared/network-accessible dev environment? If yes, prioritise upgrade to vitest@^3.

title: No npm audit CI gate — critical vulns undetected in PR pipeline
disprove_gate: After adding security-audit.yml: check workflow runs on package.json PRs

title: Upgrade debt chain: Prisma.validator → deprecated Next.js APIs → vitest CVE
evidence: vitest 2.x has critical CVE in UI mode
disprove_gate: All three are inter-related: full Next.js 15 / Prisma 6 / Vitest 3 upgrade would resolve all simultaneously
blocked_question: Is there a major-version upgrade sprint planned? These three can be batched for maximum unlock.
